title: Qualcomm unveils Dragonfly C1000, a new data center CPU built for agentic AI, and says Meta will use the chip when production starts in 2028 (Kif Leswing/CNBC)
summary: Kif Leswing / CNBC: Qualcomm unveils Dragonfly C1000, a new data center CPU built for agentic AI, and says Meta will use the chip when production starts in 2028 — Qualcomm on Wednesday revealed a central processing unit for data centers called Dragonfly C1000, and said that Meta would use it when it starts production in 2028.
